title: An abstract isomorphism of a composite with the identity makes the unit or counit invertible
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], and let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors with an adjunction $L\dashv R$ [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\to RL$ and counit $\varepsilon:LR\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$. (1) If there exists some natural isomorphism $RL\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$, not assumed to be related to $\eta$, then $\eta$ is a natural isomorphism. (2) If there exists some natural isomorphism $LR\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$, not assumed to be related to $\varepsilon$, then $\varepsilon$ is a natural isomorphism.
